name: Voye
summary: Pooled eSIM data for travelling teams, billed on actual usage rather than prepaid bundles, with per-user spend controls. Coverage and speed vary by country and carrier partner, so pilot your heaviest routes first — the vendor's roaming-savings figures stay claims until your invoice confirms them.
best_for: companies with regularly traveling teams that want one pooled global data contract, per-user controls and an end to roaming bill surprises
skip_if: travel is rare (per-trip consumer eSIMs are simpler), or your destinations are few enough for local SIM discipline
honest_knock: eSIM data pooling genuinely beats classic roaming for traveling teams, but the honest homework is coverage-and-speed on YOUR corridors: quality varies by country and local carrier partner, so pilot with two or three of your heaviest travelers before migrating everyone. And note the vendor-cited savings numbers are marketing math until your own invoice confirms them.

pricing.notes: Published plans (read 6 September 2026 on their plans page). Monthly, 30-day validity: $9.99 for 5 GB, $19.99 for 12 GB, $39.99 for 30 GB, $69.99 for 55 GB, $119.99 for 100 GB — $2.00 down to $1.20 per gigabyte. Yearly, a single payment, 365-day validity: $500 for 200 GB, $1,000 for 450 GB, $2,000 for 950 GB, $3,500 for 1,800 GB — $2.50 down to $1.94 per gigabyte. Three-month billing is exactly three times the monthly price, with no discount. Enterprise — unlimited eSIMs, priority support and onboarding — is quoted by their sales team.
